----
 
 
"A Ripple in Time" by Pokémon × Daniel Arsham is an animated series short produced as part of a collaboration between and The Pokémon Company. It was first released on February 12, 2022 on YouTube, featuring Japanese audio and English subtitles. A teaser video for the short was released on January 28, 2022.

The short was screened as part of the exhibition project A Ripple in Time (Japanese: 時の波紋 A Ripple in Time) held at NANZUKA UNDERGROUND in , Japan from February 12 to March 27, 2022, and the exhibition Artifacts of Indigo Plateau (Chinese: 石英高原的遗迹 Artifacts of Indigo Plateau) held at chi K11 art museum in , China from December 31, 2022 to May 7, 2023.

"A Ripple in Time" by Pokémon × Daniel Arsham is an animated series short produced as part of a collaboration between and The Pokémon Company. It was first released on February 12, 2022 on YouTube, featuring Japanese audio and English subtitles. A teaser video for the short was released on January 28, 2022.

The short was screened as part of the exhibition project A Ripple in Time (Japanese: 時の波紋 A Ripple in Time) held at NANZUKA UNDERGROUND in , Japan from February 12 to March 27, 2022, and the exhibition Artifacts of Indigo Plateau (Chinese: 石英高原的遗迹 Artifacts of Indigo Plateau) held at chi K11 art museum in , China from December 31, 2022 to May 7, 2023.
 

==Plot==
 and are facing a Trainer and his in a battle at a stadium, with both Trainers being down to their last Pokémon. The match is unexpectedly interrupted by the appearance of a , and after a bright flash, Ash and Pikachu find themselves in the future, where the stadium is overgrown by trees. They see Celebi and follow it through an abandoned settlement and grasslands filled with crystallized Pokémon statues. Ultimately, their chase leads them to a mysterious shrine in a cave, where suddenly appears before them and roars.

==Trivia==
In the crowd, it's possible to see some characters last seen in the original series, such as , who had last appeared in Those Darn Electabuzz!. This also marks Casey's final appearance in Pokémon.
The Trainer who battles Ash at the beginning of the short is based on Daniel Arsham himself. 
The two doors shown when Ash is running through the cave are the same doors to Bill's lighthouse from Mystery at the Lighthouse.
